description: Section structure for a feature document in docs/feat/. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/feat.md section 4; this file is its machine-checkable half. It states what every feature document carries whatever its type: Summary, Table of Contents and Key Concepts open it, the optional sections keep their relative order, sections the document invents for itself follow them, and References closes it. Usage and Implementation are optional here for every type; which type requires or forbids them is a prose rule in feat.md section 4, checked by review, never a condition here.
